directAnswer: You can transfer photos from Android to iPhone using the 'Move to iOS' app or by manually transferring them via a computer.
summary: Transferring photos from an Android device to an iPhone can be done easily with the right tools and methods, ensuring your memories are preserved.

sections.heading: Using Move to iOS App
sections.body: Apple's Move to iOS app helps transfer data from Android to iPhone seamlessly. Ensure both devices are connected to Wi-Fi.

sections.heading: Manual Transfer via Computer
sections.body: You can also transfer photos by connecting both devices to a computer and moving files directly.

steps.title: Using Move to iOS
steps.detail: 1. Download 'Move to iOS' on your Android device. 2. Set up your new iPhone and select 'Move Data from Android' during setup. 3. Open the app on Android, enter the code displayed on iPhone, and select photos to transfer.

steps.title: Manual Transfer
steps.detail: 1. Connect your Android device to a computer and copy photos to a folder. 2. Disconnect the Android device and connect your iPhone. 3. Use iTunes or Finder to sync the photos from the folder to your iPhone.

faqs.question: Will I lose any photos during the transfer?
faqs.answer: No, as long as you follow the steps correctly, all selected photos should transfer without loss.

faqs.question: Can I transfer videos as well?
faqs.answer: Yes, both the Move to iOS app and manual transfer methods support video files.

faqs.question: What if I encounter errors during the transfer?
faqs.answer: Ensure both devices are updated to the latest software version and try restarting both devices before attempting the transfer again.

caveats: The Move to iOS app only works during the initial setup of the iPhone; it cannot be used once the iPhone is already set up.
